messages:
Ethan (Sales): Hey team — enterprise POC with Orion Health is failing for EU testers. They say inference calls return a 404 for the model and sometimes a 429. Need urgent help; demo on Wed.
Riya (Solutions): Thanks Ethan. Which model and region? any logs from their side?
Ethan (Sales): Using model `redwood-xl-2.1` pinned in request. Region: eu-west-1. Customer reports: 'model not available in this region' in UI, plus intermittent 'rate limit exceeded'.
Carlos (Infra): Quick check: we deprecated redwood-xl-2.1 in some regions last month — should have auto-redirected but pin prevents fallback. That explains 404. 429s could be client hitting hosted quota or burst throttling on their account.
Riya (Solutions): If pin is required by the customer for deterministic outputs, we can provide a compatible variant: `redwood-xl-2.1-compat` (available in eu-west-1). Recommend switching their POC pin to that alias. It preserves weights + small tokenization differences.
Ana (Security): Legal/security asked about PKI and audit for dedicated/private. They also put a security questionnaire on the deal; can we confirm whether model aliasing changes any data flow or egress?
Carlos (Infra): Alias doesn't change runtime path — same serving fleet in eu-west-1. No new egress. I'll add a note for the SOC packet.
Helga (AM): Pricing question from procurement: if they switch to the compat alias but stay hosted, do rates change? Also they asked about reserved capacity if throughput hits 10k reqs/day.
Riya (Solutions): Hosting prices same for alias. For reserved capacity, we can provide a committed monthly plan — I'll loop in pricing. For POC we usually recommend hosted with a short reserve trial (2 weeks) if they expect burst tests.
Ethan (Sales): Can you confirm whether quantization changes are required for eu region? Customer asked about performance vs quality (they prefer lower latency).
Carlos (Infra): For eu-west-1 we have `q4_0` quant profile supported on the compat variant. It reduces GPU memory and latency slightly but can affect rare tokens. If they need strict parity, keep full fp16. For POC latency targets we can suggest q4_0 and measure.
Riya (Solutions): Actionable steps: 1) Ask customer to change pin to `redwood-xl-2.1-compat` (we can provide example request). 2) If they must keep original pin, we can offer a temporary routing exception but that requires approvals and ~24h prep. 3) Try q4_0 for latency test.
Ethan (Sales): Example request snippet please — customer wants to just paste it in their app.
Riya (Solutions): Paste below (send as single-line JSON):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-xl-2.1-compat",
  "input": "Summarize patient's note...",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "pin": true
}
```
Carlos (Infra): Log snippet from their POC (copied from support chat):
```
{"error":"model_not_found","message":"Model redwood-xl-2.1 not available in eu-west-1"}
{"status":429,"message":"rate limit exceeded","retry_after":14}
```
Riya (Solutions): I'll draft a short KB entry for the customer and include the pin -> alias change and quantization recommendation.
Ana (Security): For the security questionnaire: note that aliasing doesn't change compute location; add a line about KMS and audit logs being available for hosted plus Dedicated option if they need customer-managed keys.
Helga (AM): I'll handle the pricing conversion and propose a 2-week reserved trial. Ethan — I'll send that to procurement and cc you.
Ethan (Sales): Great — timeline: Riya, can you send the KB and snippet today? Carlos — can you confirm the routing exception ETA if they insist on original pin? Ana — please add the single-sentence audit note. Helga — thanks for pricing.
Riya (Solutions): Yes, will send KB + request example before EOD.
Carlos (Infra): Routing exception needs manual replica mapping and Q/A — ~24 hours once PR approved. I can start if you get customer sign-off.
Ana (Security): Added note for SOC pack and questionnaire: "Model aliasing maintains data residency; no egress; KMS + audit logs available on hosted tier. Dedicated option supports customer-managed KMS."
deploy-bot: Created ticket #INF-4128 for routing exception request.
Ethan (Sales): Perfect. I'll share the KB with the customer and push them to change the pin. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Helga (AM): Follow-up scheduled Thu 10am demo prep with Orion Health. I'll invite Riya and Carlos for technical Q&A.
Ethan (Sales): Closing loop here — will update thread after their change.
